name: cascade_delete
description: In `app.delete('/api/customers/:c_custkey', ...)`, the `Customer.destroy()` call with `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` triggers SQLite's ON DELETE CASCADE, permanently deleting all related orders. The `app.get('/api/dashboard', ...)` endpoint depends on those orders for its `total_orders` and `total_revenue` calculations, so it will now return incomplete/missing data after a customer deletion.
